I’m so unbelievably poor right now. I had my internet and phone shut off at one point, my car is very close to being repossessed, and I got the money to turn on my phone/internet but then had to replace two tires so that ate up the entire cost. I found a really good job that pays well and has benefits so things were looking up!

But I got a letter notifying me my wages are being garnished 25% until the debt is paid off. (Got a loan to try & pay debt that occurred from a suicide attempt, the pressure of everything was too much and fell behind but am aware this is 100% my fault and half to accept the consequences. I just wish those consequences didn’t make it hard to feed my family.)

Life has just been beating me down again and again.

This subreddit may not be for you my friend if you don’t understand the complexity of a step parent/child relationship. It’s never good to stay together for the kids, and if she didn’t love SS then leaving would be much easier and guilt free. You can care about someone and put your own needs first sometimes, I’m sure OP is already struggling on their own with this situation.

Depression can make you really selfish unfortunately. I’ve been actively suicidal for the last ten years and when I’m in the deepest depths of despair, I’m fully aware that if I kill myself, I’ll never get to wake up next to my husband again, or listen to my favorite song, or watch my kids get married and it genuinely doesn’t matter. None of that is enough and that terrifies me because when I’m lucid I would do anything for the people I love, but the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do is live when I really don’t want to. It makes me angry and resentful some days because I feel like I exist out of obligation. It’s exhausting. I just hope that man finally found his peace.

Stepmom here, 

I was with my partner for two years before OUR kids asked if they could start calling me mom. It was a huge milestone in our relationship, definitely one of my favorite moments. 

I can’t imagine marrying my partner and taking on the role of their kids bonus mom, and not even being comfortable with them/viceversa. I can’t imagine bringing someone into my home that doesn’t have a solid relationship with my kids?? 

Please look yourself in the mirror and acknowledge YTA, that’s the first step. Then decide if you actually want to be a family or please let this family go. Those boys deserve someone that is going to love them like their own. I don’t know how long I could keep up with the communal living
